metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's all orbit is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's just going really fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And because so many nerds are obsessed with space, people have been thinking about alternate

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: schemes for as long as they've been thinking about rockets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so one of the first things that I learned, kind of trying to explore new possibilities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: was that I could put all of my brain power to work and be creative as I could and invent

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: some idea that I thought was new for making things go fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And I would always find out that some guy in Russia or somewhere had thought the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: idea up 50 years ago and figured out all the math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so at a certain point, you give up on trying to invent completely new ideas and

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: just go poking around trying to find those guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So there's a number of ideas that we looked at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Some are crazier, some are less crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But the direction that that company eventually took was chemical rockets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Is there something you can comment on possible ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So first of all, you could use nuclear, so nuclear propulsion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So that's, I mean, you've probably heard of Project Orion, which was the Freeman Dyson

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: and some of his collaborators had a scheme to power a large space vehicle by detonating

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: atomic bombs behind it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so one of the other people who was working at Blue Operations during this time was George

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Dyson, the son of Freeman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so we knew all about Project Orion and he found an old film that they'd shot on a

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: beach in La Jolla of a prototype of this that was powered by like lumps of C4.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So that was an idea, but for a private company, obtaining a large number of atomic bombs was

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: probably out of scope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So there's more of a theoretical thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's a conceptually similar approach using lasers that Freeman worked on with Arthur

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Kantrowitz and some others where you take a pulse laser and you fire it at a vehicle

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that has a block of ice on the back and the pulse hits the ice and flashes off a layer

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: of steam that becomes plasma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And plasma is opaque because it conducts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so being opaque, it then absorbs all of the energy from the laser pulse and gets really

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: hot and just pushes on the back of the block of ice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And then you wait a moment for that to dissipate and then you do it again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it would just kind of vibrate its way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Like it sounds really violent, but Freeman said that if you were wearing like rubber

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: sold tennis shoes standing in this vehicle, you would just feel a mild vibration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So there your source of energy is on the ground and you're getting higher specific impulse

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: than you could get by burning chemicals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Jordan Kerr and others worked on another laser system, the late Dr. Jordan Kerr that just

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: would heat up a heat exchanger by many converging solid state lasers from the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And Kevin Parkin works on a similar scheme that just uses microwaves to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We looked at tall towers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I spent a while looking kind of semi seriously at giant bullwhips.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: What's a bullwhip?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Just a whip, you have them here in Texas, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, I understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But how does that have to do with propulsion?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If you think about it, a whip is an incredibly simple primitive object that can break the

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: speed of sound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it's unbelievable in a way that for thousands of years, people with no technology have been

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: able to accelerate objects through the speed of sound just through an architectural trick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Just the physics of a moving bend of material in a medium can do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So that's the thing I still think about from time to time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You can use the same physics to make freestanding loops of chain or other flexible materials

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that just kind of stand up under their own physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, it's kind of awesome to imagine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So imagine using the same kind of physics of a whip, but have at the end of it a spaceship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That would detach at the moment of maximum velocity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Why not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Why wouldn't that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So part of my motivation in studying that was to ask that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It was more almost a symbolic way of saying, look, there's all kinds of physics we haven't

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: explored yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's no more crazy than the idea of chemical rockets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's just that more money's gone into chemical rockets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Can I ask you a question on propulsion that's a little bit more out there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I don't know if you've seen quite a lot of recent articles and reports and so on about

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: UFOs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Like the Tic Tac aircraft.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I keep seeing a lot of chatter about it, but I haven't gone deep into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So the DoD released footage filmed by pilots and there's a lot of reports about objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that moved in ways they haven't seen before that seem to defy the laws of physics if we

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: consider the aircraft that we have today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So the reason I asked you that is because it kind of, to me, whatever the heck it is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: it's inspiring for the possibilities of ideas for propulsion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If it's like secret projects from foreign nations or it's physical phenomena that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: don't yet understand, like ball lightning, all those kinds of things, or if it is aliens

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: or objects from an alien civilization, I most likely believe if it's an object from an alien

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: civilization it's got to be like a really dumb drone that just got lost.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's definitely not like the pinnacle of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's like some teenagers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Science fair experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, it just flew for a few centuries out and just landed and then we humans are all

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: like really excited about this wild thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, what do you think about those, first of all, like the millions of reports of UFOs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's some psychology there that's deeply cultural, but also the possibility of aliens

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: having visited Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, I mean, I'd like to see some better pictures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: For the reason I mentioned earlier having to do with the difficulty of traveling between

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: star systems, it's really hard for me to believe it's aliens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I just can't understand why you would go to all that trouble to transport something across

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: light years and then do what these UFOs are allegedly doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: How is that interesting?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: How does that justify the trip?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If you travel across those kinds of distances, you'd make a bigger splash.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: First of all, I would expect that the arrival of these things would be something we'd notice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's got to decelerate into our solar system unless it got here really, really, really

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: slowly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I guess that's a possibility and just snuck in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: At the end, we would detect some kind of footprint in terms of energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You would think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I actually think your idea of a science fair project gone bad, it makes more sense in that

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: it would explain why if these things are alien technologies, they're just hanging around

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: our aircraft carriers for no particular reason, not trying to communicate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Can you imagine a scenario where aliens have visited Earth or are visiting Earth and we

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: wouldn't notice it at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If they've got technology to get here, they've probably got technology to conceal the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that they're here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: They're trying to conceal themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I meant more like they're not trying to conceal themselves, but our cognitive capabilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: are too limited and we are not thinking big enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We're looking for little green men.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We're looking for things that operate at a time scale that's human-like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I love thinking about ideas like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That's great science fiction novel fodder, that the aliens are so different that we simply

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: don't see them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: In terms of language, do you think it would be difficult, not aliens visiting us, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: traveling to other places to find a common language?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You've written about the importance of language in intelligent civilizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: How difficult is the problem to bridge the gap between aliens and humans in terms of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: language so we're not lost in translation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's different takes on that depending on how biologically similar they are to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's a school of thought that says basically advanced life has to be carbon-based for just

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: reasons of chemistry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Right away if you impose that limitation, then you're assuming something that's starting

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to be biologically similar to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If they're about as big as we are and they move around in space in a physical body the

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: way we do, then there's probably a way to solve that communication problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If they're like beings of pure energy from Star Trek or something like that, then it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: a different story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Well, I love thinking about that kind of stuff too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Consciousness itself may be alien.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It could be, like you said, beings of pure energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Of course, yes, it does have a utopian feel to it, but we have been making progress throughout

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: human history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Maybe this is what progress looks like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There will be the powerful and the greedy and the bureaucrats that take advantage of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: it, skim off the top kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But maybe this does give more power to people that haven't had power before in a good way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: like distributing power and enabling greater resistance to dictatorships and authoritarian

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: regimes, that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And also enabling all kinds of technologies built on top of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Ultimately, when you digitize money, money is a kind of speech or it's a kind of mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: of how humans interact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And if you make that digital, more and more of the world moves to the digital space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And then you can finally fully live in that virtual reality with the toaster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: In a lot of ways, I think in that realm of technology that the money per se is one of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the less interesting things you can do with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I think cryptographically enforceable contracts and organizations built on those, that seems

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to me like it's got more potential for change just because we do already have money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And although it's an old system, it's been digitized to a large extent by the stripes

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: and the credit card companies of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I also love the idea of connecting two smart contracts, connecting data, making it more

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: formal, it's like Mathematica, more structured, the integration of data, of weather data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: of all kinds of data about the stuff in the world so they can make contracts between people

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that's grounded in data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And that's actually getting closer to something like truth because then you can make agreements

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: based on actual data versus kind of perceptions of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And if you can formalize, like distribute the power of who gets to tell the story, that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: an interesting kind of resistance to the powerful in the space of narrative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, David Brin has been saying for a while that the only way to settle arguments across

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the political divide is to make bets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So people can say the election was stolen or whatever controversial position they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: taking and they'll keep saying it until you wager real money on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So maybe there's something there if you could kind of turn that into a, put a user interface

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, have a stake in your divisiveness, in your arguments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Will Dogecoin take over the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Twitter question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You know, I don't follow the different coins that much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I don't, I mean, I hear about Dogecoin and I've kind of followed the story of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So the interesting aspect of Dogecoin is it, so in contrast to like Bitcoin and Ethereum,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: which are these serious implementations of cryptocurrency that seek to solve some of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the problems that we're talking about with smart contracts and resist the banks and all

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: those kinds of things, Dogecoin operates more in the space of memes and humor while still

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: doing some of the similar things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it presents to the world sort of a question of whether memes, whether humor, whether narrative

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: will go a long way in the future, like much farther than some kind of boring old grounded

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: technologies, whether we'll be playing in the space of fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Like once we built a base of comfort and stability and like a robust system where everyone has

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: shelter, everyone has food and the basic needs covered, are we going to then operate in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: space of fun?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That's why I think about Dogecoin, because it seems like fun spreads faster than anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Fun of different kinds and that could be bad fun and that could be good fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so it's a battle of good fun versus bad fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It goes viral very, very quickly when you post something that people find fun to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And that's what Dogecoin represents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So Bitcoin represents like financial, like serious financial instruments and then Dogecoin

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: represents fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it's interesting to watch the battle go on on the internet to see which wins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: This is also like an open question to me of what is the internet?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Because fun seems to prevail on the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And is that a fundamental property of the internet moving forward when you look a hundred

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: years out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Or is this a temporary thing that was true at the birth of the internet and is just true

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: for a couple of decades until it fades away and the adults take over and become serious

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: again?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Well, I think the adults took over initially and then it was later on that people started

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: using it for fun, frivolous things like memes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And I think that's pretty much unstoppable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Because even people who are very serious enjoy sending around a funny picture or something

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that amuses them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I personally think we spoke about World War II.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I think memes will save the world and prevent all future wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You've been handwriting your work for the past 20 years since writing the Baroque cycle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: What are the pros and cons of handwriting versus typing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: For me, I started it as an experiment when I started the Baroque cycle because I had

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: noticed that sometimes if I was stuck having a hard time getting started, if I just picked

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: up a pen and started writing, it was easy to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I just decided to keep with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If it got in my way, I didn't like it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I could always just go back to the word processor and be fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That never happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So there's a certain security that comes from knowing that it's ink on paper and there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: no operating system crash or software failure that can obliterate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's a slower output technique.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so a sentence or a paragraph spends a longer time in the buffer up here before it

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: gets committed to paper, whereas I can type really fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so I can slam things out before I've really thought them through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I think the first draft quality ends up being higher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And then editing, first draft of editing is just faster because instead of trying to move

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the cursor around or whatever or hitting the backspace key, I can just draw a line through

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: a word or a sentence or just around a whole paragraph and exit out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And in doing so, I very quickly created an edit, but I've also left behind a record of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: what the text was prior to the edit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Of course, all the digital versions have those quote unquote features, but their experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: is different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Is there a romance to just the physical, the touch of the pen to the paper, doing what

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: has been done for centuries?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I think there is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I think there is just the simplicity of it and not having any intermediary technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: beyond the pen and the paper is just very simple and clean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so I've got a bunch of fountain pens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I started buying fancy paper from Italy a few years ago because I thought I would be

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: more conservative with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But it's still a trivial expenditure, so it doesn't really alter my habits very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So, all that said, once you do type stuff up, you use Emacs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I use Emacs, obviously the superior editor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Let me just ask the ridiculous futuristic question because Emacs has been around forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Do you think in 100 years, we will still have Emacs in Vim?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Or like, pick a, let's say 50, 100 years, 100 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, whenever you're doing anything in Linux, you're spending a lot of time editing

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: little config files and scripts and stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And you need to be able to pop in and out of editing those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it needs to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Even if the windowing GUI is dead and all you've got is a command line, to get out of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that problem, you might need to enter an editor and alter a file.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I think on that level, there will always have to be very simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Well, Emacs isn't very simple, but you know what I mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There have to be basic editors that you can use from either the command line or a GUI

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: just for administering systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Now how widespread they'll be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's a certain amount of, what's the story of the, there's the American folk tale of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the hammer guy who drives the railroad spikes, John Henry, trying to keep up with the steam

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: hammer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And eventually the steam hammer wins because he can't drive the spikes fast enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So there's a sense in which Microsoft, who knows how much they've invested in code, visual

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: studio or Apple with Xcode.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So they've put huge amounts of money into enhancing their IDEs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And Emacs in theory can duplicate all of those features by, if you just have enough Linux

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: hackers writing Emacs list macros.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But at some point it's going to be hard to maintain that level of, to keep up feature

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: for feature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The interesting thing about Emacs just is it's lasted a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: in the software engineering space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it's interesting to think about technologies that sort of last for a very long time and

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: How do they get by?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's like the cockroaches of software or the bacteria of software or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Like this base thing that nobody, everybody's just became reliant on and they just outlast

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: everything else and slowly, slowly adjust with the times with a little bit of a delay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: with a little bit of customization by individuals, kind of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But they're always there in the shadows and they outlast everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And I wonder if that might be the story for a lot of technologies, especially in the software

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: It's funny that you did that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: So that's a fascinating process.

body.input: Works fine for me.

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Is there advice you could say, what does it take to write a great story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The power of good yarns, good narratives to pull people in is incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And I think my sort of amateur theory is that it's an evolutionary development that if you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: cave person sitting around a fire in the Rift Valley a million years ago, if you can tell

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the story of how you escaped from the hyenas or how Uncle Bob didn't escape from the hyenas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And if the people listening to you can take that in and they can build that scenario in

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: their heads, like a kind of virtual reality and see what you're describing, then you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: just conferred an incredibly important advantage on the people who've heard that story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so they know a bunch of stuff now about how to stay alive that they could not have

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: learned in any other way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, animals who don't have speech though, they might warn each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: They might make a sound that says, danger, danger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But as far as we know, they can't tell more complicated stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it's a part of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, the collective intelligence seems to be one of the key characteristics of homo

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: sapiens, the ability to share ideas and hold ideas together in our minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And storytelling is the fundamental aspect of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Maybe even language itself is more fundamental because the language is required to do the

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: storytelling or maybe they evolve together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Maybe they co-evolve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So I think that you've got to work with that and I think sometimes it seems like in literary

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: circles that having a lot of plot is a little bit frowned upon as it's pulpy or it's exploitative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But for me, I don't have any compunctions whatsoever about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I like stories that are grabby and fun and exciting to read.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And once you've got one of those going, once you've got a good yarn going that people will

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: enjoy reading, then you're free to do whatever you want in the frame of that story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But if you don't have that, then you got nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: What about having like, which you do a technological scientific rigor like to the accuracy and

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: as much as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: How does that add to Bob telling the story or telling the story about Bob or on the campfire?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Well, the main thing that it does is present little details that you might not have come

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: up with on your own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So if you're just sitting there freely imagining things, your brain probably isn't going to

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: serve up the wealth of details and the resulting complications and surprises that the real

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: world is constantly presenting us with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so in my case, if I'm trying to write a story that involves some technology like

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: a rocket or orbital maneuvers or whatever, then delving into those details eventually

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: is going to turn up some weird unexpected thing that gives me material to work with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But also subliminally readers who see that are going to be drawn in more because they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: going to find that, oh, I didn't see that coming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's got some of the complexity and surprise value of the real world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It does something, Alex Garland, director who wrote, directed Ex Machina.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I think about AI movies and the more care you take in making it accurate, the more compelling

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the story becomes somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I'm not sure what that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Maybe because it becomes more real to the people writing the story, maybe it just makes

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: you a better writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The key to any storytelling is getting the readers to suspend their disbelief.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And there's all kinds of triggers and little tells that can break that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And once it's broken, it's really hard to get it back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: A lot of times that's the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Somebody will just close the book and not pick it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So if that's what you like, then Cryptonomicon or the Baroque Cycle is where you would start.
