body.input: Or at least used to be a very orderly place, high social capital, very minimal class differences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So you'd have some people who would drive a Cadillac instead of a Chevy, but that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Those were the rich people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And a college town is always a different environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Like Austin has some of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it was a pretty kind of utopian, other than the weather and a few other things, environment

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to grow up in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The martial art I ended up doing is sword stuff, which is interesting because it uses

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: a different feedback loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So if you're grappling, everything is through sense of touch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And your sense of touch is very old and simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Like earthworms don't even have eyes, but they can tell when they're being touched.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it's very fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And with a standoff art like boxing or some kinds of sword fighting, you're not touching

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the other person most of the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Your visual system is doing something way more...

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's doing slam and trying to figure out what the other person is up to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so that always felt more my speed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Also in Olympic style fencing, it doesn't start really until you're crossing blades

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: with the other person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And now you're back to wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You're feeling what they're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it's all about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But some of the older sword arts don't engage the blade that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You stand off at range and then you make cutting attacks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so those are all processed visually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And I think I'm more of a slow thinker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it works for me better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, it has the same artistry and the beauty of boxing, I suppose, just like you said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's no contact and it's all processed visually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And I'm sure there's a dance of its own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That depends on the characteristic of a sword involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But it's a set of stances and basic reactions that you try to learn that are thought to

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: be defensible and safe or safer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so it tends to be a series of short engagements where you'll close in, you'll try out your

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: idea and it works or it doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Then you back off again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's interesting to think about human history because martial arts, okay, that's a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But in terms of sword fighting, just the full range of humans that existed who mastered

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: sword fighting or sought the mastery of sword fighting, just imagine the thousands of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: who the heights they have achieved because the stakes are so incredibly high to be good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it's the richest, most powerful people in those societies spending whatever it takes

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to get the best gear and the best training.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Because you're right, everything depends on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it's still life and death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, that's fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That's fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We perhaps have lost that forever with greater weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, the artistry of sword fighting when it's life and death and you go into war, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: have the Miyamoto Masashi's of the world, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's a poetry to that, there's a mastery to that that I don't know if we could achieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: with any other kind of martial art.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Well, one of the good, you were talking earlier about the good effects of the internet, social

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: media that we sometimes overlook and one of those is that there were all these isolated

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: people around the world who were interested in this, who found each other and kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: created a network of people who help each other learn these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So that doesn't mean that anyone is up to the level that you're talking about yet, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: it is happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so there's a large number of old treatises, old written documents that have been dug up

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: from libraries and people have been going over these and translating them from old dialects

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: of Italian and German to make sense of them and learning how to do these techniques with

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: different weapons.

body.input: Actually, there's a guy here in Austin named Daman Stith who does African, historical African

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the Caribbean, South America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: He's probably within a mile of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: He's an amazing guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: That's awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I'm going to look him up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Can I ask you for advice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: When you give advice for young people, high school, college, undergrads, thinking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: their career, thinking about life, how to live a life they can be proud of, you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: quite a bit about what it's required to be innovative in this world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You think quite a bit about the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So if somebody wanted to be a person that makes a big impact on the future, what advice

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: would you give them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I think a big part of it is finding the thing that you will do happily and I don't want

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to say obsessively because that sounds like maybe it's pathological.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But if you can find a thing that you'll sit down, you'll start doing it and hours later

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: you kind of snap out of it, where did the time go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And that's a really key discovery for anyone to make about themselves when they're young

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: because if you don't have that, it's hard to figure out where you should put your energies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And as you might have the best intentions, you might say, I want world peace or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But at the end of the day, what really matters is how do you spend your time and are you

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: spending it in a way that's productive?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Because it doesn't matter how smart you are or well-intentioned you are unless you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: figured that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And so finding that thing in which you can sort of, you naturally lose yourself in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The thing is, at least for me, there's a lot of things like that, but I first have to overcome

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: the initial hump of really sucking at that thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The fun starts a little bit after the first hump of really sucking and then you could

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: suck just regularly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So oftentimes people can give up too early, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I mean, that's true with mathematics for me, for a lot of people, is if you just give it

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: a chance to struggle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If you give yourself time to struggle, you'll find a way, you'll find the thing within that

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: thing that you can lose track of time with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah, that's a key detail that there's an important thing to add to what I said, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: is that this might not happen the first time you do a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Maybe it will, but you might have to climb that learning curve and if there's pressures

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: in your life that are making you feel bad about that, then it might prevent you from

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: getting where you need to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So there's some complexity there that can make this kind of non-obvious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But that's why we need good teachers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Another beneficial thing of the internet is YouTube and being able to learn things, how

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to do things on YouTube.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: The dude who made the YouTube video doesn't care how many times you hit pause and rewind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: They're never going to roll their eyes and be impatient with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Sometimes spending a huge amount of time on one video or one book, making that the thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: you just spent a huge amount of time on rereading, rereading, or rewatching, rewatching, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: somehow really solidifies your love for that thing and the depth of understanding you start

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: to gain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And it's okay to stay with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I used to think there's all these books out there, so I need to keep reading or keep reading.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But then I realized, I think it was somewhere in college where you could just spend your

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: whole life with a single textbook.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's nothing in that textbook to really, really stay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Measner, Thorne, and Wheeler, Gravitation is one of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Or another one is The Road to Reality by Roger Penrose, which is just incredibly deep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It starts with like two plus two equals four.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And at the end, you're at the boundaries of physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's an amazing, amazing book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Let me ask you the big ridiculous question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Since you've pondered some big ridiculous questions in your work, what's the meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: of this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: What's the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Human life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Well, as far as I know, we're unique in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's no evidence that there's anything else in the universe that's as complicated

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: as what's between our ears.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: You can't rule it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So we appear to be pretty special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it's got to have something to do with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And one of the reasons I like David Deutsch, in particular his book, The Beginning of Infinity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: is that he talks about the power of explanations and the fact that most civilizations are static,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that they've got a set of dogmas that they arrive at somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And they just pass those on from one generation to the next and nothing changes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: But that huge changes have happened when people follow whatever you want to call it, the scientific

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: method or enlightenment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's different ways of thinking about it, but basically explanatory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's about the power of explanations and being able to figure out why things are the way

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: And that has created changes in our thinking and our way of life over the last few centuries

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: that are explosive compared to anything that came before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: David sort of verges on classifying this as like a force of nature in its potential transformative

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: If we keep going, if we figure out how to colonize the universe like you were talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: about earlier, how to spread to other star systems, then it is effectively a force of

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: This kind of drive to understand more and more and more, deeper and deeper and deeper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: and to engineer stuff so that we can understand even more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It's the universe created us to understand itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Maybe that's the whole purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: It is an interesting, peculiar side effect of the way we've been created is we seem to

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: be conscious beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We seem to have little egos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We seem to be born and die pretty quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's a bunch of drama.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: We're all within ourselves pretty unique and we fall in love and start wars and there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: hate and all the full interesting dynamic of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So it's not just about the individual people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Somehow like the concert that we played together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: So that's kind of interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: There's a lot of peculiar aspects of that that I wonder if they're fundamental or just

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: quirks of evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Whether it's death, whether it's love, whether all those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: I wonder if they're from an engineering perspective when we're trying to create that intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: Neal Stephenson: Sci-Fi, Space, Aliens, AI, VR & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #240

body.input: Whether that toaster should be afraid of death and should fall in love just like we do.

body.input: So in high school and right after you wrote a draft

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of a chemistry textbook, I saw that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to quantum mechanics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So it's clear you have an intuition and a passion

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: for both the physical world with chemistry and now robotics

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to the digital world with AI, deep learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: reinforcement learning, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Do you see the physical world

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and the digital world as different?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And what do you think is the gap?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: A lot of it actually boils down to iteration speed, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: That I think that a lot of what really motivates me

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is building things, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Is the, you know, think about mathematics, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: where you think really hard about a problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you understand it, you write it down

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: in this very obscure form that we call proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But then this is in humanity's library, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: It's there forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: This is some truth that we've discovered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You know, maybe only five people in your field

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: will ever read it, but somehow you've kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: moved humanity forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I actually used to really think

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that I was going to be a mathematician.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And then I actually started writing this chemistry textbook.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: One of my friends told me, you'll never publish it

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So instead, I decided to build a website

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and tried to promote my ideas that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And then I discovered programming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And you know, that in programming,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you think hard about a problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you understand it, you write it down

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: in a very obscure form that we call a program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But then once again, it's in humanity's library, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And anyone can get the benefit from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And the scalability is massive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that the thing that really appeals to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: about the digital world is that you can have

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: this insane leverage, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: A single individual with an idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is able to affect the entire planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And that's something I think is really hard to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: if you're moving around physical atoms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But you said mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So if you look at the wet thing over here, our mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: do you ultimately see it as just math,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: as just information processing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Or is there some other magic as you've seen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: if you've seen through biology and chemistry and so on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think it's really interesting to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: humans as just information processing systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And that it seems like it's actually a pretty good

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: way of describing a lot of kind of how the world works

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: or a lot of what we're capable of to think that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: again, if you just look at technological innovations

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: over time, that in some ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: the most transformative innovation that we've had

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is has been the computer, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: In some ways, the internet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: what has the internet done, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: The internet is not about these physical cables.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: It's about the fact that I am suddenly able

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to instantly communicate with any other human on the planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I'm able to retrieve any piece of knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that in some ways the human race has ever had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And that those are these insane transformations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Do you see the, our society as a whole,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: the collective as another extension of the intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of the human being?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So if you look at the human being

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: as an information processing system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you mentioned the internet, the networking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Do you see us all together as a civilization

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: as a kind of intelligent system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Yeah, I think this is actually a really interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: perspective to take and to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that you sort of have this collective intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of all of society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: The economy itself is this superhuman machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that is optimizing something, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And it's almost in some ways a company has a will

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of its own, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: That you have all these individuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: who are all pursuing their own individual goals

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and thinking really hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and thinking about the right things to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But somehow the company does something

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that is this emergent thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and that is a really useful abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that in some ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: we think of ourselves as the most intelligent things

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: on the planet and the most powerful things on the planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But there are things that are bigger than us

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that are these systems that we all contribute to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think actually, it's interesting to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: if you've read Isaac Isamov's foundation, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: That there's this concept of psycho history in there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: One thing that I actually think a lot about with OpenAI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that are far less transformative than AGI will be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that one piece is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: it's just even hard to imagine

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and to really put yourself in a world

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: where you can predict what that positive vision

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: would be like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think the second thing is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think it is always easier to support

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: the negative side than the positive side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: It's always easier to destroy than create.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And less in a physical sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and more just in an intellectual sense, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Because I think that with creating something

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you need to just get a bunch of things right

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and to destroy you just need to get one thing wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that what that means

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is that I think a lot of people's thinking dead ends

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: as soon as they see the negative story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But that being said, I actually have some hope, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think that the positive vision

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is something that I think can be,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is something that we can talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think that just simply saying this fact of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: yeah, there's positive, there's negatives,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: everyone likes to dwell on the negative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: People actually respond well to that message

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and say, huh, you're right, there's a part of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that we're not talking about, not thinking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And that's actually something that's, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: really been a key part of how we think about AGI at OpenAI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You can kind of look at it as like, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: OpenAI talks about the fact that there are risks

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and yet they're trying to build this system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: How do you square those two facts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So do you share the intuition that some people have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I mean, from Sam Harris to even Elon Musk himself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that it's tricky as you develop AGI

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to keep it from slipping into the existential threats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: into the negative?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: What's your intuition about how hard is it

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to keep AI development on the positive track?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: What's your intuition there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: To answer the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you can really look at how we structure OpenAI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So we really have three main arms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: We have capabilities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: which is actually doing the technical work

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and pushing forward what these systems can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: There's safety, which is working on technical mechanisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to ensure that the systems we build

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: are aligned with human values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And then there's policy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: which is making sure that we have governance mechanisms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: answering that question of, well, whose values?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that the technical safety one

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is the one that people kind of talk about the most, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You talk about, like think about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you know, all of the dystopic AI movies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: a lot of that is about not having

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: good technical safety in place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And what we've been finding is that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you know, I think that actually a lot of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: look at the technical safety problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and think it's just intractable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Right, this question of what do humans want?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: How am I supposed to write that down?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Can I even write down what I want?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: No way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And then they stop there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But the thing is we've already built systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that are able to learn things that humans can't specify.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You know, even the rules for how to recognize

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: if there's a cat or a dog in an image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Turns out it's intractable to write that down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And yet we're able to learn it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And that what we're seeing with systems we build at OpenAI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and they're still in early proof of concept stage,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is that you are able to learn human preferences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You're able to learn what humans want from data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so that's kind of the core focus

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: for our technical safety team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think that there actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: we've had some pretty encouraging updates

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: in terms of what we've been able to make work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So you have an intuition and a hope that from data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you know, looking at the value alignment problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: from data, we can build systems that align

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: with the collective better angels of our nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So align with the ethics and the morals of human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: To even say this in a different way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I mean, think about how do we align humans, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Think about like a human baby can grow up

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to be an evil person or a great person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And a lot of that is from learning from data, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: That you have some feedback as a child is growing up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: they get to see positive examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that just like the only example we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of a general intelligence that is able to learn from data

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to align with human values and to learn values,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think we shouldn't be surprised

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that we can do the same sorts of techniques

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: or whether the same sort of techniques end up being

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: how we solve value alignment for AGI's.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So let's go even higher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I don't know if you've read the book Sapiens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: but there's an idea that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that as a collective, as us human beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: we kind of develop together ideas that we hold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: There's no, in that context, objective truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: We just kind of all agree to certain ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and hold them as a collective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Did you have a sense that there is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: in the world of good and evil,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: do you have a sense that to the first approximation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: there are some things that are good

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and that you could teach systems to behave to be good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So I think that this actually blends into our third team,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: right, which is the policy team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And this is the one, the aspect I think people really

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: talk about way less than they should, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Because imagine that we build super powerful systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that we've managed to figure out all the mechanisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: for these things to do whatever the operator wants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: The most important question becomes who's the operator,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: what do they want, and how is that going to affect

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: everyone else, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think that this question of what is good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: what are those values, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think you don't even have to go to those

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: very grand existential places to start,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to realize how hard this problem is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You just look at different countries and cultures

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: across the world and that there's a very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: conception of how the world works

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and what kinds of ways that society wants to operate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that the really core question

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is actually very concrete.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think it's not a question

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that we have ready answers to, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: It's how do you have a world where all the different

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: countries that we have, United States, China, Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and the hundreds of other countries out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: are able to continue to not just operate

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: in the way that they see fit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: but in the world that emerges in these,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: where you have these very powerful systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: operating alongside humans ends up being something

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that empowers humans more,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that makes human existence be a more meaningful thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and that people are happier and wealthier

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and able to live more fulfilling lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: It's not an obvious thing for how to design that world

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: once you have that very powerful system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So if we take a little step back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and we're having like a fascinating conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and OpenAI is in many ways a tech leader in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and yet we're thinking about these big existential

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: questions which is fascinating and really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think you're a leader in that space

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and that's a really important space

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of just thinking how AI affects society

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: in a big picture view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So Oscar Wilde said, we're all in the gutter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: but some of us are looking at the stars

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and I think OpenAI has a charter that looks to the stars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I would say, to create intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to create general intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: make it beneficial, safe, and collaborative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Can you tell me how that came about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: how a mission like that and the path

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: to creating a mission like that at OpenAI was founded?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Yeah, so I think that in some ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: it really boils down to taking a look at the landscape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So if you think about the history of AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that basically for the past 60 or 70 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: people have thought about this goal

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of what could happen if you could automate

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: human intellectual labor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Imagine you can build a computer system that could do that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: what becomes possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: We have a lot of sci-fi that tells stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of various dystopias and increasingly you have movies

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: like Herd that tell you a little bit about

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: maybe more of a little bit utopic vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You think about the impacts that we've seen

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: and computers and I think that the impact

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: of computers and the internet has just far outstripped

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so I think that it's very clear

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so what it boils down to then is a question of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: well, is there a path?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Is there hope?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Is there a way to build such a system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think that for 60 or 70 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that people got excited and that ended up

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: not being able to deliver on the hopes

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that people had pinned on them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And I think that then, after two winters of AI development,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: that people I think kind of almost stopped daring to dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Really talking about AGI or thinking about AGI

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: became almost this taboo in the community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: But I actually think that people took the wrong lesson

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: from AI history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And if you look back, starting in 1959

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: is when the Perceptron was released.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: It was released to what was perceived

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: as this massive overhype.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So in the New York Times in 1959,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: you have this article saying that the Perceptron

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And people at the time looked at this and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: this is, your system can't do any of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And basically spent 10 years trying to discredit

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: the whole Perceptron direction and succeeded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And all the funding dried up and people kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: went in other directions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And in the 80s, there was a resurgence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And so of course, they weren't able to get great results.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: I think there are three core properties

body.input: We have a very small number of deep learning tools.

body.input: SGD, deep neural net, maybe some RL.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And it solves this huge variety of problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: So there's the generality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: There's a second piece, which is the competence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: You wanna solve any of those problems

body.input: replace it with a deep neural net, it's gonna work better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: And there's a third piece, which is the scalability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: One thing that has been shown time and time again

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: throw more compute, more data at it, it will work better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

body.input: Those three properties together feel like essential parts

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17

metadata.title: Podcast: Greg Brockman: OpenAI and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #17
