metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I'm doing this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I do want to ask you about one specific idea that sounds super fascinating that you're involved with recently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You led the $50 million seed round for a company called Colossal that is focused on de-extinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: This is funny relative to our connection and conversation about Jurassic World.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: They're seeking to restore lost ecosystems and use gene editing to restore the woolly mammoth to the Arctic tundra.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How are they going to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Well, I met this fascinating guy at Harvard named George Church five, six years ago and found him to be incredibly smart, have an imagination.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: And he partnered up with a guy named Ben Lamb, who's an entrepreneur.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: And basically the press and to me the imaginative, you're capturing my imagination by telling me you're going to bring back the woolly mammoth and other extinct animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: And we'll see where that road leads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I was more interested in an investor in the things that they're working through around understanding genes and proteins and CRISPR and all these other things, because being adjacent to George Church and his team, as these things unfold over the next decade, I thought was the right thing to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: So people are important here, just like investing in people and seeing what the hell they come up with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Absolutely. I mean, you can look through history and great things are done by great people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Right. And companies, they end up over time becoming a logo and immediately what you think of them. But they started out with a person with an idea and a team that cultivated that and made that happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: And I think there are certain folks that are just immensely talented that if you can be around them, and I also know his and his team's ethics in terms of after spending time talking about where the lines are, people in other countries that may not have the same process, may not have the same checks and balances, are doing this and pursuing this regardless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: So at least I felt like with George and Ben and their teams, they're also very responsible people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: This is where the human side of things comes into play. I've interacted with a lot of really brilliant people in the technology space where you kind of, you know, there's a lot of ways to feel this out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You can ask them whether they kind of read literature, you can feel out how much they really understand about like human nature here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Like whatever the technology is, when it actually starts to play, interact with society at scale, like do they have an understanding or an intuition about how that happens?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Some of that requires studying history. Some of that requires like just looking at the worst and best parts and events in human history to understand like, hey, it doesn't always turn out like everybody hoped the technology turns out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: If a person has a depth of understanding about history, about human nature, then I think that's the right person to mess with some of this cutting edge stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You want Marcus Aurelius with a PhD from MIT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Exactly. Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Just small tangent, but you mentioned having a conversation with Warren Buffett. You spoke really highly of him as an investor, as a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What about him do you admire? What insights have you drawn from him as a great investor yourself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Well, the afternoon that I got to spend with him, which, you know, something I'll treasure forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Look, sometimes when you meet people, even that are immensely successful, you may decide that after 20 minutes or a half hour, oh, you were in the right place at the right time and that's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: There are other people that are clearly different, special, and I don't care if you made them start from zero, would end up in a good place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It was an absolute privilege to spend the time with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: A couple of things that stood out in the conversation. He is incredibly intellectually curious and well read.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I like how simplistic he likes to keep his thought matrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Then also, instead of trying to outsmart the market, it seems like a simple axiom, but just look, good companies that are led by talented managers that are good businesses over time are going to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I'm not going to day trade. I'm looking for value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Then just on life stuff, and also his ability to take in and then use information was incredibly impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I had met him before, but I only spent one afternoon with him, but it's pretty incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: One of the things that stuck out to me is we were in the middle of talking about Talco or investing or how we thought about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I said, I'm trying to be smart about, and he stopped me and he said, Charlie Munger, his partner of many years, Charlie and I don't try to think of the smart thing to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: We try to think what's the dumb thing we could do here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I laughed and he said, no, I'm dead serious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: We think about it from the standpoint of what could we do in this situation that later we'd be like, that was a really dumb thing to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I actually thought that was, it got in my head and I still think a lot about that as I'm dissecting problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's a long-term thinking if you just avoid the dumb things or if you simplify, just focus on those simple steps, all it takes is just do that for a long period of time and you'll be successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It certainly worked for him. That's all I can say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What about you? You've been a great investor yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How do you know when you judge people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Whenever I go to San Francisco, I was thinking of moving to San Francisco.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's why I decided to, after really giving it some thought, talking to people, decided to move to Austin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Everybody's dreaming big and they have big plans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It's actually, I don't envy the job of an investor of any kind because everybody has big dreams and it's hard to know who exactly, what idea is going to materialize, what team is going to materialize into something great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How do you make those decisions about people, about ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Well, if I had any kind of a lattice work on this, it absolutely starts with the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I think the reason for that is your business plan is going to change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: There's very few businesses I know of that say, we're going to make a widget in this location and 30 years later, we're successful and we just make a widget.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Things happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Today, they happen with such velocity that you have to be able to make hard decisions based on imperfect information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How are you going to calculate those answers?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How self-interested are you going to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What kind of ethics will you apply?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What's your short-term versus long-term thinking?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Are you able to give an honest assessment of a situation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Because the thing that you can count on is problems are going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Things you didn't anticipate are going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How pliable are you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: How much elasticity is there in your ability to be successful?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I think it's important when you invest in something that you both see, you understand the roadmap ahead and agree to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It doesn't mean there won't be twists and turns, but you're not like, wait a minute, what did we do here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: This isn't what was in the thing I signed up for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Then I think honesty and communication is a huge thing to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I always tell people bidirectionally, if there's something going on, start the conversation with, Lex, we have a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Okay, now I'm sitting up, you have my full attention, we're going to talk about whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Bad news should travel faster than good news.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Because it's going to happen, being in business with someone that is going to shoot you straight and sometimes say, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I don't know what the answer is. I got to go figure it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That I can process a lot better than, look, I don't want you mad at me or disappointed or I can't handle not having success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: We're just going to kick the can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I think especially in today's business environment, that's very, very dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's a bad sign, not just because it's good to communicate and be honest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: If they're not willing to do that, then it goes back to the intellectual honesty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: They're probably not also able to be brutally honest with themselves when they look in the mirror about the direction of the company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Look, I wasn't there, so I don't know. But I think if you unpack many situations that turned out negatively,

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: most of the people, whether you're faking lab results, you have a biotech company, everybody's staring at Theranos these days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Do I think in a lot of cases, you're either the villain, like you started out saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I'm going to screw my shareholders over and I'm going to be a liar. That isn't my experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Most things are little incremental moves that you say, we're going to get this right next week, but today we got to make the presentation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: We're going to just tweak things a little bit. That's a slippery slope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's why I think from a standpoint of people, you want to go into the foxhole with folks that understand things are going to happen

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: and I'm going to let you know about them and we're going to try to solve them together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Then just in terms of the idea, I always ask, okay, if this company executed the way...

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's the other thing that always cracks me up about financials. Whenever somebody pitches you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: inevitably they'll say, our projections are really, really conservative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I'm still waiting for somebody to come in and say, look, my projections are wildly optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: We'll never hit these numbers, but anyway, if this company did what it says and executes, does it matter?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Does it move the needle enough? What are the things that uniquely position this company to be successful?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You just have to be able to answer, I think, a number of those questions pretty crisply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: At the end of the day, it's still a big risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259
Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You're just trying to minimize the risk. Let me jump to another topic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You're an incredible human being that you're involved with this. Your band, Ghost Hounds, is touring with the Rolling Stones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Before we talk about your band, let me ask about that. What's that like, playing with the Rolling Stones?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Surreal, just because they're my favorite band of all time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: To me, the greatest rock and roll band. It's not even close of all time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: To share the same stage, to be on tour, and to go out and get that energy from the crowd.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Every night, you come off stage, and later when they go on, and you hear that iconic, ladies and gentlemen, the Rolling Stones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It's incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What's amazing to me about the band, next year will be their 60th anniversary. 60 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It's hard to be around anything for that long, but making music and packing stadiums.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What's amazing to me, they can play a two-hour set. It's not just that, oh, that's a hit, or you recognize it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Every song is an anthem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It's been amazing. We got to play with them in 2019, and when they ask us to do this again, it's just an absolute privilege.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I asked you this offline, so I know you are a rock star. Just me, maybe I'm projecting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Do you get nervous, such a large audience with the Rolling Stones? It feels like there would be a lot of pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Yeah. You definitely don't want to screw it up. I think our band is tight-knit and all that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I think that the individual nervousness dissipates when you go out as a group, and you're making music together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: You're sort of, okay, we're all in this, and we're doing a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Even in sports, I always look at individual events like ice skating, or anything where it's just you out there alone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: That's different than being with a team and nerve-racking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: I'm sure if it was me with an acoustic guitar just going out, it would feel different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: But absolutely, you get the right kind of butterflies, I would call it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Just the energy of playing music and having it be this relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Look, I get it. I've been to a ton of concerts where I'm like, look, can we just get to the band, please?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: But what's been great is just an amazing reception.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: We have this guy named Trey Nation as the lead singer who's just incredibly talented.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: He's just not only an amazing voice, but just has that charismatic thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: He's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: It's fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: What's it feel like to play in front of a huge audience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: As a guitarist, are you lost in the music?

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

metadata.title: Podcast: Thomas Tull: From Batman Dark Knight Trilogy to AI and The Rolling Stones | Lex Fridman Podcast #259

body.input: Does it add extra energy? Does it add extra anxiety? What does it feel like?
