metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Is that in high school?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Is that in college?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: That was in high school, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And then that was really about trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to be able to do more powerful things than what Pascal could

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: do and also to learn a different world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So he was really confusing to me with pointers

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and the syntax and everything, and it took a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But Pascal's much more principled in various ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: C's more, I mean, it has its historical roots,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but it's not as easy to learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: With pointers, there's this memory management thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that you have to become conscious of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Is that the first time you start to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that there's resources that you're supposed to manage?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Well, so you have that in Pascal as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But in Pascal, the carrot instead of the star,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: there's some small differences like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But it's not about pointer arithmetic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: In C, you end up thinking about how things get laid out

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: in memory a lot more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so in Pascal, you have allocating and deallocating

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and owning the memory, but just the programs are simpler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And you don't have to, well, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Pascal has a string type.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so you can think about a string

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: instead of an array of characters

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: which are consecutive in memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So it's a little bit of a higher level abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So let's get into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Let's talk about LLVM, C-Lang, and compilers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So can you tell me first what LLVM and C-Lang are?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And how is it that you find yourself the creator

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and lead developer, one of the most powerful compiler

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: optimization systems in use today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So I guess they're different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So let's start with what is a compiler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Is that a good place to start?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: What are the phases of a compiler?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: What are the parts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Yeah, what is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So what is even a compiler used for?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So the way I look at this is you have a two-sided problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of you have humans that need to write code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And then you have machines that need

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to run the program that the human wrote.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And for lots of reasons, the humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: don't want to be writing in binary

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and want to think about every piece of hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so at the same time that you have lots of humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you also have lots of kinds of hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so compilers are the art of allowing humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to think at a level of abstraction

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that they want to think about, and then get that program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: get the thing that they wrote to run

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: on a specific piece of hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And the interesting and exciting part of all this

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is that there's now lots of different kinds of hardware,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: chips like x86 and PowerPC and ARM and things like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but also high-performance accelerators

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: for machine learning and other things like that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: are also just different kinds of hardware, GPUs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: These are new kinds of hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And at the same time, on the programming side of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you have basic, you have C, you have JavaScript,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you have Python, you have Swift,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you have lots of other languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that are all trying to talk to the human in a different way

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to make them more expressive and capable and powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so compilers are the thing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: goes from one to the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And then from the very beginning to the very end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so you go from what the human wrote

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and programming languages end up being about

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: expressing intent, not just for the compiler

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and the hardware, but the programming language's job

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is really to capture an expression

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of what the programmer wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that then can be maintained and adapted

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and evolved by other humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: as well as interpreted by the compiler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So when you look at this problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you have on the one hand humans, which are complicated,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and you have hardware, which is complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so compilers typically work in multiple phases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so the software engineering challenge

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that you have here is try to get maximum reuse

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: out of the amount of code that you write,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: because these compilers are very complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so the way it typically works out

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is that you have something called a front end

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: or a parser that is language specific.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so you'll have a C parser, and that's what Clang is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: or C++ or JavaScript or Python or whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that's the front end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Then you'll have a middle part,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: which is often the optimizer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and then you'll have a late part,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: which is hardware specific.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so compilers end up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: there's many different layers often,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but these three big groups are very common in compilers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And what LLVM is trying to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is trying to standardize that middle and last part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so one of the cool things about LLVM

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is that there are a lot of different languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that compile through to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so things like Swift, but also Julia, Rust,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Clang for C, C++, Subjective-C,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: like these are all very different languages,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and they can all use the same optimization infrastructure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: which gets better performance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and the same code generation infrastructure

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: for hardware support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so LLVM is really that layer that is common

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that all these different specific compilers can use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And is it a standard, like a specification,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: or is it literally an implementation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: It's an implementation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so it's, I think there's a couple of different ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of looking at it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Because it depends on which angle you're looking at it from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: LLVM ends up being a bunch of code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Okay, so it's a bunch of code that people reuse

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and they build compilers with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: We call it a compiler infrastructure

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: because it's kind of the underlying platform

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that you build a concrete compiler on top of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But it's also a community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And the LLVM community is hundreds of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that all collaborate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And one of the most fascinating things about LLVM

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: over the course of time is that we've managed somehow

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to successfully get harsh competitors

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: in the commercial space to collaborate

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: on shared infrastructure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so you have Google and Apple, you have AMD and Intel,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you have Nvidia and AMD on the graphics side,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you have Cray and everybody else doing these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And like all these companies are collaborating together

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to make that shared infrastructure really, really great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And they do this not out of the goodness of their heart,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but they do it because it's in their commercial interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of having really great infrastructure

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that they can build on top of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And facing the reality that it's so expensive

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that no one company, even the big companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is very complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: There's just a lot there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And when you talk about the front end,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: one of the major challenges which clang as a project,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: the C, C++ compiler that I built, I and many people built.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: One of the challenges we took on was we looked at GCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Okay, GCC at the time was like a really good

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: industry standardized compiler

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that had really consolidated a lot of the other compilers

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: in the world and was a standard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But it wasn't really great for research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: The design was very difficult to work with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And it was full of global variables and other things

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that made it very difficult to reuse

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: in ways that it wasn't originally designed for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so with clang, one of the things that we wanted to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is push forward on better user interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So make error messages that are just better than GCCs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And that's actually hard because you have to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: a lot of bookkeeping in an efficient way

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to be able to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: We want to make compile time better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so compile time is about making it efficient,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: which is also really hard when you're keeping track

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of extra information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: We wanted to make new tools available.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So refactoring tools and other analysis tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that GCC never supported,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: also leveraging the extra information we kept,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but enabling those new classes of tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that then get built into IDEs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so that's been one of the areas that clang

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: has really helped push the world forward in

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: in the tooling for C and C++ and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But C++ and the front end piece is complicated

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and you have to build syntax trees

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and you have to check every rule in the spec

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and you have to turn that back into an error message

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to the human that the human can understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: when they do something wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But then you start doing what's called lowering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So going from C++ and the way that it represents code

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: down to the machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And when you do that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: there's many different phases you go through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Often there are, I think LLVM has something like 150

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: different what are called passes in the compiler

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that the code passes through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And these get organized in very complicated ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: which affect the generated code and the performance

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and compile time and many other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: What are they passing through?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So after you do the clang parsing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: what's the graph?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: What does it look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: What's the data structure here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Yeah, so in the parser, it's usually a tree

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and it's called an abstract syntax tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so the idea is you have a node for the plus

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that the human wrote in their code or the function call.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: You'll have a node for call with the function that they call

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and the arguments they pass, things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: This then gets lowered into what's called

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: an intermediate representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and intermediate representations are like LLVM has one

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and there it's what's called a control flow graph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so you represent each operation in the program

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: as a very simple, like this is gonna add two numbers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: this is gonna multiply two things, maybe we'll do a call

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but then they get put in what are called blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so you get blocks of these straight line operations

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: where instead of being nested like in a tree,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: it's straight line operations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so there's a sequence and an ordering

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to these operations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So within the block or outside the block?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: That's within the block.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so it's a straight line sequence of operations

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: within the block.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And then you have branches, like conditional branches

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: between blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so when you write a loop, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: in a syntax tree, you would have a four node

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: like for a four statement in a C like language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: you'd have a four node.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And you have a pointer to the expression for the initializer

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: or a pointer to the expression for the increment

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: a pointer to the expression for the comparison,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: a pointer to the body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Okay, and these are all nested underneath it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: In a control flow graph, you get a block for the code

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: that runs before the loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So the initializer code, then you have a block

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: for the body of the loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so the body of the loop code goes in there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but also the increment and other things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And then you have a branch that goes back to the top

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and a comparison and a branch that goes out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so it's more of a assembly level kind of representation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: But the nice thing about this level of representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is it's much more language independent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And so there's lots of different kinds of languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: with different kinds of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: JavaScript has a lot of different ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of what is false, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: and all that can stay in the front end,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but then that middle part can be shared across all those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: How close is that intermediate representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: to neural networks, for example?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Is there, are they, because everything you describe

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is a kind of a neural network graph.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: Are they neighbors or what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: They're quite different in details,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: but they're very similar in idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: So one of the things that neural networks do

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: is they learn representations for data

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: at different levels of abstraction, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: And then they transform those through layers, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Lattner: Compilers, LLVM, Swift, TPU, and ML Accelerators | Lex Fridman Podcast #21

body.input: of this one population or people interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: in this one population basically in real time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: From the individual level to the group level,

body.input: psychologically speaking, what's their motivation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: If they're just after money, how do they sleep at night?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: to basically make someone's life a living hell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And what I found was there's kind of this long sorted history

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: to this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: It started out in the 80s and 90s

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: when hackers were just finding holes and bugs in software

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: for curiosity sake, really as a hobby.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And some of them would go to the tech companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: like Microsoft or Sun Microsystems at the time or Oracle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And they'd say, hey, I just found this zero day

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: in your software and I can use it to break into NASA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And the general response at the time wasn't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: thank you so much for pointing out this flaw

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and our software will get it fixed as soon as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: It was, don't ever poke around our software ever again

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: or we'll stick our general counsel on you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And that was really sort of the common thread for years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And so hackers who set out to do the right thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: were basically told to shut up

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and stop doing what you're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And what happened next was

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: they basically started trading this information online.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Now, when you go back and interview people

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: from those early days, they all tell a very similar story

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: which is they're curious, they're tinkers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: They remind me of like the kid down the block

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that was constantly poking around the hood of his dad's car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: They just couldn't help themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: They wanted to figure out how a system is designed

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and how they could potentially exploit it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: for some other purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: It doesn't have to be good or bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But they were basically kind of beat down for so long

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: by these big tech companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that they started just silently trading them

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: with other hackers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And that's how you got these really heated debates

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: in the 90s about disclosure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Should you just dump these things online

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: because any script kiddie can pick them up

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and use it for all kinds of mischief.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But don't you wanna just stick a middle finger

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: to all these companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that are basically threatening you all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: So there was this really interesting dynamic at play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And what I learned in the course of doing my book

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: was that government agencies and their contractors

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: sort of tapped into that frustration and that resentment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And they started quietly reaching out to hackers

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: on these forums.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And they said, hey, you know that zero day

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: you just dropped online,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: could you come up with something custom for me

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and I'll pay you six figures for it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: so long as you shut up and never tell anyone

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that I paid you for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And that's what happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: So throughout the 90s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: there was a bunch of boutique contractors

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that started reaching out to hackers on these forums

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and saying, hey, I'll pay you six figures

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: for that bug you were trying to get Microsoft

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: to fix for free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And sort of so began or so catalyzed this market

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: where governments and their intermediaries

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: started reaching out to these hackers

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and buying their bugs for free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And in those early days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: I think a lot of it was just for quiet counterintelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: traditional espionage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But as we started baking the software, Windows software,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Schneider Electric, Siemens Industrial Software

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: into our nuclear plants and our factories

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and our power grid and our petrochemical facilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and our pipelines,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: those same zero days came to be just as valuable

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: for sabotage and war planning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Does the fact that the market sprung up

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and you can not make a lot of money

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: or grow the number of attackers?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: I mean, what is, I guess you told the psychology

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: of the hackers in the 90s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: what is the culture today and where is it heading?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: So I think there are people who will tell you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: they would never sell a zero day

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: to a zero day broker or a government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: One, because they don't know how it's gonna get used

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: when they throw it over the fence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Most of these get rolled into classified programs

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and you don't know how they get used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: If you sell it to a zero day broker,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: you don't even know which nation state might use it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: or potentially which criminal group might use it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: if you sell it on the dark web.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: The other thing that they say is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: they wanna be able to sleep at night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And they lose a lot of sleep if they found out

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: living hell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But there are a lot of people, good people who also say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: no, this is not my problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: This is the technology company's problem.

body.input: If they weren't writing new bugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: into their software every day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: then there wouldn't be a market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: You know, then there wouldn't be a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But they continue to write bugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: into their software all the time

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and they continue to profit off that software.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: So why shouldn't I profit off my labor too?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And one of the things that has happened,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: which is I think a positive development

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: over the last 10 years are bug bounty programs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Companies like Google and Facebook and then Microsoft

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and finally Apple, which resisted it for a really long time

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: have said, okay, we are gonna shift our perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: about hackers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: We're no longer going to treat them as the enemy here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: We're going to start paying them

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: for what it's essentially free quality assurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And we're gonna pay them good money in some cases,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: you know, six figures in some cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: We're never gonna be able to bid against a zero day broker

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: who sells to government agencies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: but we can reward them and hopefully get that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: to that bug earlier where we can neutralize it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: so that they don't have to spend another year

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: developing the zero day exploit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And in that way we can keep our software more secure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But every week I get messages from some hacker that says,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: you know, I tried to see this zero day exploit

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that was just found in the wild, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: being used by this nation state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: I tried to tell Microsoft about this two years ago

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and they were gonna pay me peanuts, so it never got fixed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: You know, there are all sorts of those stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: that can continue on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And, you know, I think just generally hackers

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: are not very good at diplomacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: You know, they tend to be pretty snipey, technical crowd

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and very philosophical in my experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: But, you know, diplomacy is not their strong suit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Oh, there almost has to be a broker

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: between companies and hackers

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: where you can translate effectively,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: just like you have a zero day broker

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: between governments and hackers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Because you have to speak their language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: Yeah, and there have been some of those companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And there's low-hanging fruit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And I hope Congress does something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And frankly, I think it's negligent they haven't

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And I mean, my dad was in the hospital last year

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: It's not just a spam bot that's messaging

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: and a comment that's in a reply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: They are saying, okay, this person cares

body.input: Oh, okay, cool, I wanna talk to Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: And I get angry at the people that do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: I mean, it's like the John that gets hired,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: I mean, I suppose the solution is education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: That balance with the technology solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: of creating maybe like two-factor authentication

body.input: and maybe helping identify things

metadata.title: Podcast: Nicole Perlroth: Cybersecurity and the Weapons of Cyberwar | Lex Fridman Podcast #266

body.input: That everybody has to click on now,
