body.input: Was Genghis Khan doing anything wrong?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It depends on how you look at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Well, he drew a line somewhere where this is us

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and that's them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It's the circle of empathy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It's like these, you don't have to use the word consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: but these are the things that matter to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: if they suffer or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And these are the things that don't matter to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Yeah, but when one of his commanders failed him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: he broke his spine and let him die in a horrible way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And so in some sense, I think he was indifferent to suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: He was not indifferent in the sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that he didn't see it as useful if he inflicted suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: But he did not see it as something

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that had to be avoided.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: That was not the goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: The question was, how can I use suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and the infliction of suffering to reach my goals

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: from his perspective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: I see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So different societies throughout history

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: put different value on the-

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Different individuals, different psyches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: But also even the objective of avoiding suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Some societies probably, I mean, this

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is where religious belief really helps, that afterlife,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that doesn't matter that you suffer or die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: What matters is you suffer honorably, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So that you enter the afterlife.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It seems to be superstitious to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Basically, beliefs that assert things for which no evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: exist are incompatible with sound epistemology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And I don't think that religion has to be superstitious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Otherwise, it should be condemned in all cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: You're somebody who's saying we live in a dream world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: We have zero evidence for anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: That's not the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: There are limits to what languages can be constructed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Mathematics brings solid evidence for its own structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And once we have some idea of what languages exist

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and how a system can learn and what learning itself

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is in the first place, and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: we can begin to realize that our intuitions, that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: are able to learn about the regularities of the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and minimize appraisal and understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: the nature of our own agency to some degree of abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: That's not an illusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It's a useful approximation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Just because we live in a dream world

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: doesn't mean mathematics can't give us

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: a consistent glimpse of objective reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: We can basically distinguish useful encodings

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: from useless encodings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And when we apply our truth seeking to the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: we know we usually cannot find out

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: whether a certain thing is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: What we typically do is we take the state

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: vector of the universe, separate it into separate objects that

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: interact with each other, so interfaces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And this distinction that we are making

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is not completely arbitrary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It's done to optimize the compression

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that we can apply to our models of the universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: so we can predict what's happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: with our limited resources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: In this sense, it's not arbitrary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: But the separation of the world into objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that are somehow discrete and interacting with each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is not the true reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: The boundaries between the objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: are projected into the world, not arbitrarily projected,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: but still.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It's only an approximation of what's actually the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And we sometimes notice that we run into contradictions

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: when we try to understand high level things

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: like economic aspects of the world and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: or political aspects, or psychological aspects, where

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: we make simplifications.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And the objects that we are using to separate the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: are just one of many possible projections

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: of what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So it's not, in this postmodernist sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: completely arbitrary, and you're free to pick what you want

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: or dismiss what you don't like because it's all stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: No, that's not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: You have to show for every model of how well it

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: predicts the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So the confidence that you should have

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: in the entities of your models should correspond

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: to the evidence that you have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Can I ask you on a small tangent to talk

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: about your favorite set of ideas and people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: which is postmodernism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: What?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: What is postmodernism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: How would you define it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And why, to you, is it not a useful framework of thought?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Postmodernism is something that I'm really not an expert on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And postmodernism is a set of philosophical ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that is difficult to lump together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that is characterized by some useful thinkers, some of them

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: post-structuralist and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And I'm mostly not interested in it

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: because I think that it's not leading me anywhere

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that I find particularly useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It's mostly, I think, born out of the insight

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that the ontologies that we impose on the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: are not literally true and that we can often

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: get to a different interpretation by the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: by using a different ontology that

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is different separation of the world into interacting objects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: But the idea that this makes the world a set of stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that are arbitrary, I think, is wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And the people that are engaging in this type of philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: are working in an area that I largely don't find productive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: There is nothing useful coming out of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So this idea that truth is relative

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is not something that has, in some sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: informed physics or theory of relativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And there is no feedback between those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: There is no meaningful influence of this type of philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: on the sciences or on engineering or in politics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: But there is a very strong information of this on ideology

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: because it basically has become an ideology that

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is justifying itself by the notion that truth

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is a relative concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And it's not being used in such a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: that the philosophers or sociologists that take up

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: these ideas say, oh, I should doubt my own ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: because maybe my separation of the world into objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is not completely valid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And I should maybe use a different one

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and be open to a pluralism of ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: But it mostly exists to dismiss the ideas of other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: is also an excellent reason for dying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: I therefore conclude that the meaning of life

body.input: is the most urgent of questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So I have to ask what, Jascha Bach, is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: It is an urgent question according to Camus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: I don't think that there's a single answer to this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Nothing makes sense unless a mind makes it so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: So you basically have to project a purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And if you zoom out far enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: there's the heat test of the universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and everything is meaningless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: Everything is just a blip in between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And the question is, do you find meaning in this blip?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: into the future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: of the world that you like to the future

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: and trying to serve that aesthetic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And if you do, then life has that meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Joscha Bach: Nature of Reality, Dreams, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #212

body.input: And if you don't, then it doesn't.

body.input: The following is a conversation with Noam Chomsky, his second time in the podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: This episode is focused on the war in Ukraine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316
