metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I decided it's best to get Noam's clear thoughts on this war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: and the complicated geopolitics of today and the rest of the 21st century that is unrolling before us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: with our decisions and actions fully capable of either helping humanity flourish or unleashing global destruction and suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: As a brief aside, perhaps you know this, but let me mention that I traveled to Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: and saw, heard, felt things that are haunting and gave me a lot to think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Because of that, I've been really struggling to edit the videos I recorded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I hope to finish it soon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I'm sorry for these delays, and I'm especially sorry to the people there who gave me their time, their story, their heart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Please be patient with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I hope you understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: To support it, please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: And now, dear friends, here's Noam Chomsky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Particular insight into Putin's mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I can only watch the actions over the last 20, 25 years and read the statements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Took power about almost 25 years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Has held it since as Prime Minister or President.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: His first task was to try to overcome the chaos and disarray of the 1990s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: During the 90s, Gorbachev had a proposal he called for a cooperative enterprise with the West.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: They would share an effort to rebuild what he called a common European home,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: in which there would be no military alliances, just rather a sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Russian-Western U.S. accommodation with a move towards social democracy in former USSR

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: and comparable moves in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Well, that was quickly smashed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The United States had no interest in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Clinton came along pretty soon, early 90s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Russia was induced to adopt what was called shock therapy, harsh, quick market transformation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: which devastated the economy, created enormous social disarray,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: rise of what are called oligarchs, kleptocrats, high mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Clinton started the policy of expanding NATO to the East in violation of firm,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: unambiguous promises to Gorbachev not to do so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Yeltsin, Putin's friend, opposed it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Other Russian leaders opposed it, but they didn't react.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: They accepted it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: When Putin came in, he continued that policy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Meanwhile, he did reconstruct the Russian economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Russian society became a viable, deeply authoritarian society under his tight control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: He himself organized a major kleptocracy with him in the middle of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: He became very wealthy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: On the international front, he pretty much continued the former policies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: As U.S. diplomats, practically every diplomat who had any contact with Russia had been dispatched there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: knew about it, as they all warned from the 90s that what Clinton was doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: expanded by Bush, Bush too, afterwards, was reckless and provocative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Russia did have a clear red line before Putin, which he adhered to, namely no NATO membership for Ukraine and Georgia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: This is pretty much how things went on through the 2000s, 2014, 2008.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: President George Bush did invite Ukraine to join NATO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: That was vetoed by France and Germany, but under U.S. pressure, it was kept on the agenda.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The Russians continued to object to Western diplomats, including the present current head of the CIA,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: and its predecessors warned that this was reckless, provocative, shouldn't be done, continued.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Putin didn't do much. He stayed with it until pretty recently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: After 2014, the uprising that threw out the former president, who was pro-Russian, instituted anti-Russian laws,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: the United States and NATO began a policy of moving to effectively integrate Ukraine into the NATO command.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Joint military exercises, training, sending weapons, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Putin objected, other Russian leaders objected. They're unified on this, but didn't do much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: They continued with the proposals that Ukraine be excluded from NATO and that there be some form of autonomy for the Donbass region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Meanwhile, in reaction to the uprising, the Maidan uprising in 2014, Russia moved in and took over Crimea, protecting its one warm water base and major naval base.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The U.S. objected and recognized it, but things continued without notable conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I'll go through all the details. When Joe Biden came in, he expanded the program of what U.S. military journals call de facto integration of Ukraine within NATO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: In September 2021, he proposed an enhanced program of preparation for NATO admission.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: He extended it with a formal statement in November. We're now practically up to the invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Putin's position hardened France, mainly France to an extent, Germany did make some moves towards possible negotiations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Putin dismissed them, moved on to the direct invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: What are his, to get back to your question, what motivates him? I presume what he's been saying all along, namely establishing his legacy as a leader who overcame the extensive destruction of Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: massive weakening over it, restored his position as a world power, prevented Ukraine from entering NATO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It may have further ambitions as to dominating and controlling Ukraine, very likely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: There is theory in the West that he suddenly became a total madman who wants to restore the great Russian empire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: This is combined with the gloating over the fact that the Russian military is a paper tiger that can't even conquer cities a couple of kilometers from the border,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: but defended not even by a regular army.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: But somehow along with this, he's planning to attack NATO powers, conquer Europe, who knows what.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's impossible to put all these concepts together. They're totally internally contradictory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So what's my judgment? I think what motivates him is what he's been demonstrating in his actions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Restore Russia as a great power, restore its economy, control it as a total dictatorship, enrich himself and his cronies, establish a legacy as a major figure in Russian history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: make sure that Ukraine does not join NATO, and probably by now he's hardened the position, maintain Crimea and the southeastern corridor to Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: and some ambiguous agreements about the Donbass region. That looks like his motivation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: There's much speculation that goes beyond this, but it's very hard to reconcile with the assessment of the real world by the same people who are making the grandiose speculations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Putin has been in power for 22 years. Do you think power has corrupted him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I don't think anything's changed. It seems to me his policies are about the same as what they were. They've changed in response to changed circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So very recently, right before the invasion, a few weeks before, for the first time, Putin announced recognition of the independence of the Donbass region. That's a stronger position than before, much stronger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Up till then, he had pretty much kept to the long-standing position of some kind of accommodation within a federal structure in which the Donbass region would have considerable autonomy. So that's a harshing of the position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So even the human mind of Vladimir Putin, the man?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I can't read his mind. I can only see the policies that he's pursued and the statements that he's made. There are many people speculating about his mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: And as I say, these speculations are, first of all, not based on anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Never said anything about trying to conquer NATO. But more importantly, they are totally inconsistent with the analyses of Russian power by the same people who are making the speculations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So we see the same individual speculating about Putin's grandiose plans to become Peter the Great and conquer, start attacking NATO powers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: On the one hand, saying that, on the other hand, gloating over the fact that his military powers so minuscule he can't even conquer towns a couple miles from the border.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's impossible to make sense of that position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Why did Russia invade Ukraine on February 24th? Who do you think is to blame? Who do you place the blame on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Well, who's to blame? Any power that commits aggression is to blame.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So I continue to say, as I have been for many months, that the invasion, Putin's invasion of Ukraine, is on a par with such acts of aggression as the US invasion of Iraq, the Stalin, Hitler invasion of Poland,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: and other acts of the supreme international crime under international law, aggression, of course, is to blame.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The US committed $6.9 billion in military assistance to Ukraine since the Russian invasion. Should US keep up with the support?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: There are two questions. One has to do with providing support for defense against the invasion, which is certainly legitimate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The other is seeking ways to end the crime before even worse disasters arise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The second part is not discussed in the West, barely discussed. Anyone who dares to discuss it is immediately subjected to a flood of invective and hysterical condemnation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: But if you're serious about Ukraine, there are two things you ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: One, what can we do to support Ukraine in defense against aggression? Second, how can we move to end the war before it leads to even worse destruction of Ukraine, more starvation worldwide,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: reversing the efforts, the limited efforts to deal with global warming, possibly moving up an escalation out of the war, the nuclear war? That's the second half of the borough, a phrase attributed to Winston Churchill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: There's a lot of war, war, but no joy, joy, joy. And there ought to be joy, joy if you care about Ukraine and the rest of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Can it be done? We don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Official U.S. policy is to reject a diplomatic settlement, to move to weaken Russia severely so that it cannot carry out further aggression, but not do anything on the joy, joy side, not think of how to bring the crimes and atrocities to an end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: That's the second part of the question. So, yes, the U.S. should continue with the kind of calibrated support that's been given.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The Pentagon wisely has vetoed initiatives to go well beyond support for defense up to attack on Russia. So far, the Pentagon, which seems to be the dovish component in the U.S. administration, has vetoed plans which very likely would lead on to nuclear war, which would destroy everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So, calibrated provision of weapons to blunt the offensive, allow Ukraine to defend itself, if sensible, combined with efforts to see if something can be done to bring the crimes and atrocities to an end, and avert the much worse consequences that are in store.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: That would be all, instead, the U.S. only dealing with the first. And all of our discussions limit themselves to the first in the United States and in Britain, not in Europe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Do you worry about nuclear war in the 21st century? How do we avoid it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Anyone who doesn't worry about nuclear war doesn't have a gray cell functioning. Of course, everyone is worried about nuclear war, and they should be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's very easy to see how steps could be taken, even been recommended, that would lead to nuclear war. So, you can read articles even by liberal commentators who say we should drop all the pretenses, just go to war against Russia, they have to be destroyed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: You can see proposals coming from Congress, the leading figures, saying we should establish a no-fly zone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Pentagon objects, they point out correctly, that to establish a no-fly zone, you have to have control of the air, which means destroying Russian air defense systems, which happen to be inside Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: We don't know that Russia won't react. Even the call, now almost universal, to ensure that Ukraine wins, drives out all the Russians, drives them out of the country, sounds nice on paper, but notice the assumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The assumption is that Vladimir Putin, this madman who just seeks power and is out of control, will sit there quietly, accept defeat, slink away, not use the military means that, of course, he has to destroy Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: One of the interesting comments that came out in today's long article, I think Washington Post, reviewing a lot of leaks from, actually, not leaks, actually, presented by US intelligence and US leaders about the long buildup to the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: One of the points it made was surprised on the part of British and US leaders about Putin's strategy and his failure to adopt to fight the war the way the US and Britain would, with real shock and awe, destruction of communication facilities, of energy facilities, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: They can't understand why he hasn't done all of that. Well, could. If you want to make it very likely that that'll happen, then insist on fighting until somehow Russia faces total defeat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Then it's a gamble, but if he's as crazy and insane as you claim, presumably will use weapons that he hasn't used yet to destroy Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So the West is taking an extraordinary gamble with the fate of Ukraine, gambling that the madman, lunatic, mad Vlad, won't use the weapons he has to destroy Ukraine and set the stage for escalation of the latter, which might lead to nuclear war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's quite a gamble. How much propaganda is there in the world today in Russia, in Ukraine, in the West?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's extraordinary. In Russia, of course, it's total. Ukraine is a different story. They're at war. You expect propaganda. In the West, well, let me quote Graham Fuller, very highly placed in US intelligence, one of the top officials for decades,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: dealing mostly with Russia and Central Asia. He recently said that in all the years of the Cold War, he's never seen any extreme Russophobia to the extent that he sees today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: That's pretty accurate. I mean, the US has even canceled Russian outlets, which means if you want to find out what Sergey Lavrov, other Russian officials are saying, you can't look it up on their own outlets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: You have to go through Al Jazeera, Indian state television or someplace where they still allow Russian positions to be expressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: And of course, the propaganda is just outlandish. I think Fuller is quite correct on this. In Russia, of course, you expect total propaganda. There's nothing. Any independent outlets such as there were have been crushed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: If the media is a source of inaccuracies and even lies, then how do we find the truth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I don't regard the media as a source of inaccuracies and lies. They do exist. But by and large, media reporting is reasonably accurate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Reporters, the journalists themselves, in the past, do courageous, honest work. I've written about this for 50 years. My opinion hasn't changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: But they do pick certain things and not other things. There's selection, there's framing, there's ways of presenting things. All of that forms a kind of propaganda system, which you have to work your way through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: But it's rarely a matter of straight outright lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So there's a difference between propaganda and lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Of course, a propaganda system shapes and limits the material that's presented. It may tell the truth within that framework.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So let me give you a concrete example, which I wrote about extensively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I have a book called Manufacturing Consent jointly with Edward Herman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's about his term, which I had accepted a propaganda model of the media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: A large part of the book is defense of the media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Defense of the media against harsh attacks by Freedom House.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Several volumes they published attacking the media, charging that the media were so adversarial and dishonest that they lost the war in Vietnam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Well, it took the trouble of reading through the two volumes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: One volume is charges. The next volume is evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Turns out that all of the evidence is lies. They had no evidence. They were just lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The media, in fact, were doing, the journalists were doing an honest, courageous work, but within a certain framework.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: A framework of assuming that the American cause was basically just, basically honorable, making mistakes, doing bad things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: But the idea of questioning that the United States was engaged in a major war crime, that's off the record.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So unfortunately, there was this crime and that crime which harmed their effort to do good and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Well, that's not lying. It's propaganda.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So how do we find the truth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: How do we find the truth? That's what you have a brain for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's not deep. It's quite shallow. It's not quantum physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Put a little effort into it. Think about, look for other sources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Think a little about history. Look at the documentary record.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It all pretty well falls together and you can get a reasonable understanding of what's happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: If you could sit down with Vladimir Putin and ask him a question or talk to him about an idea, what would you say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I would walk out of the room, just as with almost any other leader.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I know what he's going to say. I read the party line. I read his pronouncements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: He doesn't want to hear from me. Am I going to say, why did you carry out a crime that's comparable to the US invasion of Iraq and the Stalin-Hitler invasion of Poland?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Am I going to ask that question?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: If I met with John F. Kennedy, would I ask, why did you radically escalate the war in Vietnam, launch the US Air Force, authorize NAEPOM,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: drive launch programs to drive the villagers who you know are supporting the National Liberation Front, drive them into concentration camps to separate them from the forces they're defending?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Would I have asked him that? That's a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Do you think the people who led us into the war in Vietnam, the war in Afghanistan and Iraq, the war in Ukraine are evil?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I mean, it's very hard to be in a position of leadership of a violent, aggressive power without carrying out evil acts. Are the people evil?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I mean, I'm not their moral advisors. I don't know anything about them. I look at their actions, their statements, their policies, evaluate those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Other families can evaluate their personalities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Will there be a war between US and China in the 21st century?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: If there is, we're finished.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Okay. A war between the US and China would destroy the possibilities of organized life on Earth. In fact, we can put it differently. Unless the US and China reach an accommodation and work together and cooperatively,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: it's very unlikely that organized human society will survive. We are facing enormous problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Problems, destruction of the environment, endemics, threat of nuclear war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: None of these decline of democratic functioning of an arena for rational discourse. None of these things have boundaries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: We either work together to overcome them, which we can do, or we'll all sink together. That's the real question we should be asking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: What the United States is doing is not helping. So current US policy, which is perfectly open, nothing secret about it, is to what's called encircle China, the official word, with sentinel states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: South Korea, Japan, Australia, which will be heavily armed, provided by Biden with precision weapons aimed at China, backed by major naval operations, huge naval operations just took place in the Pacific.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Many nations participating didn't get reported here, as far as I know, but an enormous operation threatening China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: All of this to encircle China, to continue with policies like that. Somebody like Pelosi, just to probably make her look more, I don't know what her motives are, taking a highly provocative, stupid act,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: opposed by the military, opposed by the White House, yes, acts like that, which of course called for the response of highly dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: We don't have to do that. We don't have to increase the threat. I mean, right now, the last NATO summit, take a look at it, for the first time it invited to attend countries that are in the sentinel states surrounding China,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: encircling China from the east. It in fact extended the range of NATO to what's called the Indo-Pacific region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: By now, the North Atlantic includes the whole Indo-Pacific region to try to ensure that we can overcome the so-called China threat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: We might ask exactly what the China threat is. It's done sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So former Prime Minister of Australia, Paul Keating, well-known international diplomat, had an article a while ago in the Australian press, that's right in the claws of the dragon, asking, going through what the China threat is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: He ran through the various claims, finally concluded. The China threat is that China exists. It exists. It does not follow US orders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's not like Europe. Europe does what the United States tells it to do, even if it doesn't like it. China just ignores what the US says.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: There's a formal way of describing this. There are two versions of the international order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: One version is the UN-based international order, which theoretically we subscribe to, but we don't accept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The UN-based international order is unacceptable to the United States because it bans US foreign policy, literally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It explicitly bans the threat or use of force in international affairs, except under circumstances that almost never arise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Well, that's US foreign policy. Try to find a president who isn't engaged in the threat or use of force in international affairs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So obviously we can't accept the UN-based international system, even though under the Constitution that's the supreme law of the land. It doesn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So the United States has what's called a rule-based international order. That's acceptable because it's the United States that sets the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So we want a rule-based international order where the US sets the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: In commentary in the United States, even in scholarship, almost 100% calling for a rule-based international order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Is that false? No, it's true. Is it propaganda? Of course it's propaganda because of what's not said and because of what's presupposed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: An answer to an earlier question. Well, China does not accept the rule-based international order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So when the US imposes demands, Europe may not like them, but they follow them. China ignores them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So take, for example, the US sanctions on Iran. The US has to punish Iran because the United States unilaterally pulled out of the Iran nuclear agreements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So in order to punish Iran for wrecking the agreements in violation of Security Council orders, we impose very harsh sanctions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Europe strongly opposes the sanctions, condemns them harshly, but it adheres to them because you don't disobey US orders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: That's too dangerous. China ignores them. They're not keeping to the rule-based international order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Well, that's unacceptable. In fact, it's said pretty openly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: You can hear the Secretary of State and others saying that China is challenging our global hegemony.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Yes, they are. They don't accept US global hegemony, especially in the waters off China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: So that's a China threat. They do a lot of rotten things, China. I mean, internally, there's all kinds of repression, violence and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: But first of all, that's not a threat to us. And second, the US doesn't care about it because it easily accepts and supports

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: comparable crimes and atrocities internal to allies. So yes, we should protest it, but without hypocrisy, we have no standing to protest it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: We support it, comparable things in all sorts of other places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Just take a look at the US foreign aid. The leading recipient is US foreign aid is Israel, which has engaged in constant terror, violence and repression, constant almost daily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Second leading recipient is Egypt under the worst dictatorship in Egypt's history. That's 60,000 people in jail, political prisoners, tortured and so on. Do we care?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Second leading recipient. I mean, what are we talking about? That's why most of the world just laughs at us. There's a lot of failure to understand here about why the global South doesn't join us in our proxy war against Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: fighting Russia until it's severely weakened. They don't join us. Here the question is what's wrong with them? Look into their minds to figure out what's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: They have a different attitude. They say, yes, we oppose the invasion of Ukraine, terrible crime. But what are you talking about? This is what you do to us all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: You don't care about crimes like this. That's most of the global South. We can't comprehend that because we're so insulated that we are just obviously right and everyone who doesn't go along must be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Do you think the United States as a global leader, as an empire, may collapse in this century? Why and how will it happen and how can we avoid it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The United States can certainly harm itself severely. That's what we're doing right now. Right now, the greatest threat to the United States is internal countries tearing itself apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I mean, I really don't have to run through it with you. Take a look at something as elementary as mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The United States is the only country outside of war. Life expectancy is declining. Mortality is increasing. This doesn't happen anywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: You take a look at health outcomes generally. They're among the worst among the developed societies. And health spending is about twice as high as the developed societies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: You look at the charts, all of this starts around the late 1970s, early 80s. To go back to that point, the United States was pretty much a normal developed country in terms of mortality, incarceration, health expenses, other measures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Since then, the United States has fallen off the chart. It's gone way off the chart. Well, that's the neoliberal assault of the last 40 years. It's had a major effect on the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's left a lot of anger, resentment, violence. Meanwhile, the Republican Party has simply drifted off the spectrum. It's not a normal political party in any usual sense, not what it used to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Its main policy is block anything in order to regain power. That's its policy. It's stated almost openly by McConnell, followed religiously by the entire Congress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: That's not the actual political party. So of course, democracy has declined, violence has increased. The judgments, the decisions of the Supreme Court, the court's the most reactionary court in memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: To go back to the 19th century, decision after decision is an effort to create a country of white supremacist Christian nationalists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I mean, scarcely hidden. If you read the opinions of Alito, Thomas, Gorsuch and others, it's a... So yes, we can destroy ourselves within.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: And in fact, the ways we're doing it are almost astonishing. So it's well known, for example, everybody knows that U.S. infrastructure, bridges, subways and so on, is in terrible shape, needs a lot of repair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The American Association of Engineers gives it a failing mark every year. Finally, Congress did pass a limited infrastructure bill, say rebuild bridges and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It has to be called a China Competition Act. We can't rebuild our bridges because they're falling apart. We have to rebuild their bridges to beat China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: It's pathological. And that's what's happening inside the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Take Thomas's decision in the recent case in which he invalidated a New York law. This is last October, a couple weeks ago, invalidated a New York law going back to 1913 that required people to have some justification if they wanted to carry concealed weapons in public.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: He was through that with a very interesting decision. He said the United States, he said, is such a decaying, collapsing, hateful society that people just have to have guns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: I mean, how can you expect somebody to go to the grocery store without a gun in a country as disgusting and hideous as this one? It's essentially what he said. Those weren't his words, but they were the import.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: What gives you hope about the United States, about the future of human civilization?

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Human civilization will not survive unless the United States takes a lead, a leading position in dealing with and overcoming the very severe crises that we face.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: The United States, the most powerful country, not only in the world, but in human history, is nothing to compare with it. What the United States does has an overwhelming impact on what happens in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: When the United States pulls out alone, pulls out of the Paris agreements on dealing with climate change and insists on maximizing the use of fossil fuels and dismantling the regulatory apparatus that provides some mitigation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: when the United States does that, as it did under Trump, it's a blow to the future of civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: When Republican states today, right now, say they're going to punish corporations that seek to take the climate change into account in their investments, the US is telling the world, we want to destroy all of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Again, not their words, but their import. That's what they mean. So as long as we have a political organization dedicated to gaining power at any cost, maximizing profit, no matter what the consequences, no future for human civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Noam, thank you for talking today. Thank you for talking once again. And thank you for fighting for the future of human civilization. Again, thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316

body.input: Thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Noam Chomsky: Putin, Ukraine, China, and Nuclear War | Lex Fridman Podcast #316
